web_blocks.html: Dual Verdict Summary (Nov 12, 2026 NSE Close ₹1,807.20): Business Quality rates CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with KPI health PASS_WITH_WATCH [1, 8, 24]. New Capital Verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT under Tier 3 Turnaround rules, with 0.0% cash deployed above ₹1,765.44. For the 15 Zerodha shares already held (₹27,108 value, 0.63% portfolio weight, ₹1,810.51 cost), Holding Action is HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP with 0 shares sold today and a strict close stop at ₹1,570.64.

The Industrial Reality (Chapters 1–6): Aurobindo scaled over forty years without heavy equity dilution [5, 24]. Q2 FY27 sales reached a record ₹10,263 Cr, up 23.9% YoY, on a 21.0% EBITDA margin (₹2,156 Cr) and ₹1,124 Cr net profit [1]. Treasury kept USD 189 million (₹1,812 Cr) net cash even after paying USD 250 million for Lannett, ₹300 Cr upfront for Khandelwal Labs, and ₹800 Cr in buybacks [1, 13, 15]. Kakinada Penicillin-G reached a 10,000-tonne run rate and already turns positive operating cash ex-PLI [2]. Still, three drags keep business quality out of elite status. Eugia Unit I drew USFDA Warning Letter 320-26-115 in August 2026 beside active OAI tags at Units II and III [8, 9]. Return on capital fell from 27% to 12.9%, and inventory sits at 326 days with a 252-day cash cycle [24].

The Price and Tape Reality (Chapters 7–9): Shares trade at 25.73x Screener TTM EPS of ₹70.23 [28]. That stands 29% above Aurobindo's five-year median P/E of 19.9x [28]. Normalized ex-greenfield free cash flow (₹3,826 Cr) must grow 10.1% yearly for ten years just to justify today's enterprise value [2, 4]. Across 12–18 months, Bear (₹1,270), Base (₹2,060), and Bull (₹2,520) cases yield an Expected Value of ₹1,977.50, or +9.42% upside [26]. Risk to the ₹1,570.64 stop is -13.09%, giving just 1.07:1 Reward-to-Risk at ₹1,807.20. Waiting inside ₹1,680.29–₹1,765.44 lifts Reward-to-Risk cleanly to 1.51:1–2.21:1.

book_paragraphs: This book answers one practical question: should an investor buy Aurobindo Pharma shares today, hold existing shares, or walk away? Across nine chapters, we inspect the firm twice. First, we audit operations completely blind to the share price so ticker moves never cloud business truth. Second, we test market expectations, peers, and price structure.

Why examine Aurobindo closely right now? After years of heavy plant spending and US price wars, three growth engines clicked together in 2026. Kakinada's Penicillin-G plant scaled to 10,000 tonnes a year with positive cash flow. Europe crossed one billion euros in annual revenue, and US sales jumped post-Lannett to lift Q2 FY27 revenue to ₹10,263 crore with 189 million dollars in net cash.

Still, honest underwriting never hides the drags. Sterile subsidiary Eugia carries active USFDA Warning Letters at Units I and III. Warehouse stock takes 326 days to turn, while consolidated return on capital sits near 12.9 percent—far below peak years above 25 percent.

Our Dual Verdict separates new cash from current holdings cleanly. Fresh capital stays on hold under WAIT FOR SUPPORT. Buying at ₹1,807.20 offers just 1.07-to-1 reward-to-risk against our ₹1,570.64 stop. Meanwhile, the 15 Zerodha shares already held earn HOLD WITH HARD STOP so they keep riding the 47-week Stage 2 uptrend with strict exit rules.
